provenance.scope: Full-title benchmark, earlier seed/order studies and measured research additions. Each report states its own cohort.
provenance.uncertainty: Paired group-bootstrap intervals for differences between methods.
provenance.identity: Exact Spotify track IDs; no verified recording crosswalk in the measured run.

model_scope.benchmark: Standard 12-tag reranker fitted on all 804,485 training titles. This is the three-seed benchmark.
model_scope.seed_charts: Earlier CF/title seed-count study using its original fitted tagger and fixed references.
model_scope.teaching_tools: Invented counts and rankings; not evaluation results.
model_scope.cutoff_cases: Actual saved hit ranks rescored at K=1..20. Individual cases, not model averages.
model_scope.eda: Measured from the complete staged MPD and its existing grouped split. No models are fitted.
model_scope.studio_audit: Prespecified requests to the live API. Functional behavior, not held-out relevance.
model_scope.unified_studio: Frozen expanded-profile pipeline measured in the separate Studio report.

protocols.benchmark: Three seeds; 5000 test queries; every remaining track is a reference.
protocols.seed_study: Same playlist cohort and reference set at every budget. First 20 deterministic shuffled tracks form the seed pool. Unrevealed seed-pool tracks may be candidates but do not receive credit.
protocols.sequence: Same 20 known tracks, first fixed; original directed adjacency recovery.

seed_study.seed_rule: Smallest tested budget attaining at least 95% of peak validation NDCG@20 for the learned-title ranker.
seed_study.reference_protocol: Same playlist cohort and reference set at every budget. First 20 deterministic shuffled tracks form the seed pool. Unrevealed seed-pool tracks may be candidates but do not receive credit.

eda.scope: Measured from the complete staged MPD and its existing grouped split. No models are fitted.
eda.text_note: Non-ASCII is a script diagnostic, not language identification.

cases.note: No seed co-occurrence evidence. Used title or selected context with training popularity.

studio_audit.scope: Prespecified constructed requests against the deployed API. No hidden references or listener judgments. This is not Recall, NDCG or a population failure rate.

freeze.tempo_ablation: At least two known seed tempos; median +/-10 BPM, clipped to 30..300. No test tuning.
freeze.selection: Frozen deployed settings. No tuning or model selection in this command.

studio_evaluation.scope: Same sampled queries and references for all methods and cutoffs. The BPM ablation uses a prespecified +/-10 BPM window around the median of at least two known seed tempos; it falls back to ordinary Studio when tempo is unavailable. No hidden reference determines the tempo target. Explicit user tags are absent; their contract is checked separately. Unknown unrecorded development cohorts cannot be certified.
